# awsjson

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/awsjson"
```

```go
const ContentType = "application/x-amz-json-1.1"
```

<a name="Decode"></a>
## func [Decode](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/awsjson/awsjson.go#L60>)

```go
func Decode(r io.Reader, v any) error
```

Decode reads a JSON request body into v. An empty body is treated as "\{\}". Malformed JSON or a type mismatch becomes SerializationException, like AWS. Unknown members are ignored \(AWS ignores them too\).

```go
func DecodeBytes(body []byte, v any) error
```

DecodeBytes is Decode for an in\-memory body.

<a name="Time"></a>
## type [Time](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/awsjson/awsjson.go#L21>)

Time is a timestamp serialized as epoch seconds with millisecond precision \(e.g. 1762430000.123\), which is how AWS JSON 1.1 encodes timestamps.

```go
type Time struct{ time.Time }
```

```go

```

NewTime returns a \*Time, or nil for the zero time \(so omitempty drops it\).
